name: Hornero Elsewhen
description: World timezone converter panel for distributed teams: scrub hours forward or back to compare meeting times and working-hour overlap across UTC, Americas, Europe and Asia. Pure-JS, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: interactive timezone converter across UTC, Americas, Europe and Asia with hour scrubber and working-hour overlap indicators.

workStartHour.description: Start of working hours for team overlap highlights.

workEndHour.description: End of working hours for team overlap highlights.

showOffHours.description: Show cities currently outside working hours.
